messages:
Priya: Heads-up from a call with Cloud Partner procurement: they want a clear commit ladder + what happens on renewal if usage is lower than expected. Can we lock a simple policy?
Dan: We should do a commit ladder (3 bands) + a smoothing credit that vests. Keeps finance happy and avoids refunds.
Lena: Draft proposal:
```
Band 1: $100k+ yr -> 8% discount + $8k smoothing credit (vests monthly over 6mo)
Band 2: $300k+ yr -> 14% discount + $25k smoothing credit
Band 3: $700k+ yr -> 22% discount + $60k smoothing credit + SI success credit $20k
Renewal rule: if trailing 3mo avg utilization < 65% -> customer can elect 3mo extension OR apply up to 50% of remaining smoothing credit to next term.
```
Omar: Legal note: avoid "refund" language. Call it "applied credits" and require a remediation plan signed by both parties to unlock smoothing credit redemption.
Priya: Good. Marketplace SKU naming: "Redwood Reserved Commit - <band> (Private Offer)" and separate SKU for SI delivery. Keep description short; attach details to private-offer PDF.
Dan: Announcement cadence: co-announce 1 week after closing if SI assets and joint case study are ready; publish private-offer on marketplace 2 weeks after close. No pricing until partner sign-off.
Lena: Ops requirement: meter parity clause. Marketplace meter must reconcile to our internal usage within 10 business days. Disputes within 45 days.
Omar: Add a non-stacking clause: private-offer credits do not stack with promo credits unless RevOps signs off. Also floor discount = 5% without CRO approval.
Priya: Partner marketing needs a short FAQ for procurement + an example spreadsheet (fast ramp / slow ramp / partial adoption). I'll own that.
partner-bot: Task created: commit-ladder-and-smoothing-playbook -> owner: Priya, due_in: 4 business days (id: PB-4312).
Dan: I'll draft the contract language for remediation and SI milestone.
Lena: I'll prep the SKU naming and the short private-offer attachment template.
Priya: Thanks — we'll regroup after drafts. :thumbsup:
